svg.aria-label: Waveform L: two latents per symbol, beside a pilot
svg.text: Waveform L: two latents per symbol, beside a pilot
Each symbol puts one latent on I and the next on Q (16.5 a second, shown slowed down). Every 16th is a known reference.
dark: I, light: Q, orange: reference
goes up and down: needs a linear rig
